t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy. A steel-blue hairline zone-reference border runs around the edge with numbers along the top and bottom and letters down the sides. Top-left: a small grey eyebrow, a large light-weight off-white sans-serif headline in sentence case and a steel-blue mono document code. Across the middle: a full-width three-column hairline table with steel-blue mono row numerals for <CONTENT>. Bottom-right: a drawing title block of stacked mono uppercase cells with drawing number and revision. Flat, square corners, calm and formal.
signature_idea: The section is set as a drawing sheet: zone border, document code under the headline and a title block in the corner frame an ordinary table.
strengths: navy, off-white and one steel-blue accent with a light headline and mono codes are on-brand
zone border and title block are cheap to build and instantly read as engineering
table is clear and readable at size
weaknesses: plain table only, no visual idea beyond the sheet frame
tick-scale ruler, tiny figure glyph, vertical hairline and corner bracket are decorative and mean nothing
zone letters and numbers do not index anything on the sheet
no limestone surface, so the section is a single dark slab
an empty dash cell and an incomplete retention phrase look unfinished
brand_fit_why: Palette, light headline, mono codes and square hairline structure match, but it is a plain table with decorative drawing furniture.
